scopeNote: Zero real vendor/model/native turns. Only B-owned paths. No second coordinator/ledger/lifecycle. Original main before-write guard, complete registration, proof and barrier untouched. Twelve services, all ledgers, two historical report diffs and untracked b16-real-begin.mjs preserved.
previouslyPassingKept: large-first-frame ref discovery, foreign payload refusal, complete command tuple and 48KB clamp were already closed and are not re-dispatched

intermediateChunkRejected.before: the length guard demanded length == total - offset, which only holds for the LAST chunk, so every legal intermediate chunk was refused and the 135540-byte replay regressed
intermediateChunkRejected.after: only bounds are enforced: offset + decodedBytes must not exceed total, and decoded bytes must not exceed the requested length. Intermediate chunks are legal again

largeFrameOrdering.before: a frame bigger than the budget closed the page before the size test, so it was only referenceable on a later page
largeFrameOrdering.after: the size test runs first, so a large frame becomes a reference wherever it appears in the stream, including first

cases: B26-FIRST-PAGE-REFERENCE-DISCOVERY - the large frame returned as a reference with payloadBytes 135586 and a matching digest, and the page advanced seq 1,2,3 with no gap
B26-MULTI-CHUNK-PAYLOAD-MIDDLE-AND-LAST - five chunks covering all 135586 bytes, including intermediate chunks
B26-FULL-DIGEST-MATCH - reassembled payload reproduces the referenced SHA-256
B26-FOREIGN-PRODUCER-PAYLOAD-REFUSED - a foreign producer is refused with identity_mismatch
B26-SCOPE-NOT-NATIVE - no installed agent or gateway
observedPositive.note: decoded byte counts are asserted per chunk against the declared length, so the old base64-character unit error cannot hide here

strict: direct strict + exactOptionalPropertyTypes compile of runner-service.ts and recovery-transport.ts exits 0

notDone.milestone1_full: NOT PASSED. facts->ref->payload continuity is now observed, but unified dispatch and the real rebind of fact-receipt ACK, payload read and native-write-admission onto the attach channel are still absent, and the same-Runner two-client handover has no passing proof
notDone.unifiedDispatch: endpoint command path and original stdio path still not proven to share ONE dispatch
notDone.threeChannelRebind: ACK, payload and write admission still belong to the original stdio channel
notDone.RFC: docs/rfcs/WP-03/0001-b-runner-business-attach.md exists and was corrected in wave-25; it is not yet re-issued for the reference-page and producer-bound payload behaviour added now

limitations: the observed positive runs against a controlled endpoint whose facts/payload backends are fixture-shaped, not the full product journal path
no coordinator SIGKILL recovery, no ACK window, no recovered verify/candidate/accept, no 2/4 slots
one of four runnable milestones published
